note: One-patient wiring test of the localized sampler on the frozen r2 weights. Frozen with the card on 2026-11-22 after two reviews by Codex; experiments/registry/EXP-2026-008.md holds the design and the frozen evaluation. The representation, sampling, text and evaluation blocks of configs/experiments/EXP-2026-001.json are used as frozen.
patient_rule: the accepted RHUH development case (pinned to training) with the median pre-op core volume (IDs 1 and 3); lower median, ties by patient ID

slab.rule: contiguous axial slices with the largest summed pre-op core area; ties go to the lowest start

arm_notes.image: the start image, which is also the composition source and the source the anchoring follows; W2 starts from noise and is composed with the scaffold
arm_notes.mask: the mask start: for free arms the anchoring source of the mask stream, for fixed arms the fixed mask; W0 and the scaffolds report it as their mask
arm_notes.prompts: supplied-scenario prompts of the arm's scenario; W6e uses the residual prompts of W6
